title: Social Media Manager Job at the Vault Recruitment (TVR)
content:
The Vault Recruitment (TVR) is a fast growing recruitment firm specializing in connecting top talent with SME's and Startup organizations. Our team of experienced recruiters understands the unique needs and challenges of the modern job market and uses our extensive network and industry knowledge to find the best candidates for our clients. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Social Media Manager

Vacancy Code: OMOW001
Job Location: Surulere,  Lagos
Employment Type: Hybrid (3 times in a week)

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a creative and results-driven Social Media Manager to manage our online presence, increase brand awareness, engage our audience, and support business growth through strategic social media activities.
	The ideal candidate should be passionate about digital marketing, content creation, and community engagement.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement social media strategies aligned with business goals.
	Create, schedule, and publish engaging content across social media platforms.
	Manage the company's social media accounts, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
	Monitor audience engagement and respond to comments, messages, and inquiries promptly.
	Track and analyze social media performance using analytics tools.
	Create graphics, videos, and other multimedia content using design tools such as Canva.
	Stay updated on industry trends, social media best practices, and emerging platforms.
	Collaborate with internal teams to promote products, services, campaigns, and events.
	Generate monthly performance reports and provide recommendations for improvement.
	Grow online communities and increase brand visibility.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in any field.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in social media management.
	Proficiency in Canva, CapCut, and social media scheduling tools.
	Strong content writing and communication skills.
	Basic knowledge of social media analytics and reporting.
	Creative mindset with excellent attention to detail.
	Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
	Must be a resident in Surulere or nearby areas for easy commute.


Salary
N90,000 / month.

Quality Control Officer Job at Carew Couture

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Quality Control Officer 

Job Location: Lagos

Description
     

            
    




	We’re looking for skilled, responsible and detail-oriented individuals to join our team.
	Inspects garments to ensure correct measurements, design, stitching, material, neatness and overall quality.

Requirements


	Excellent attention to detail, knowledge of garment construction, good communication and organisation, basic computer skills, and confidence to stop production when standards are not met.

content:
At News central TV, we are boldly amplifying African voices and challenging dominant narratives through fearless reporting. We are on DSTV 422, GOTV 23, StarTimes 274, AVO 23.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Intern

Job Location: Lagos

Requirements
     

            
    




	Interested applicant(s) should possess relevant qualifications and experience.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV / Application Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.) News Editor

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary


	We’re looking for someone who can identify the stories that matter, respond effectively to breaking news, coordinate newsroom teams and maintain high editorial standards in a demanding news environment.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: If you’re ready to contribute to a newsroom covering stories from across Africa and the world, kindly apply.

 

 

3.) Vision Mixer

Job Locations: Lagos

Role Summary


	The primary responsibility is to execute the visual narrative of a live broadcast by switching between multiple camera feeds, digital assets, and remote sources in real-time.
	Operating in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment, the Vision Mixer collaborates closely with the Director to ensure a seamless and engaging viewer experience.


Key Responsibilities


	Operate the vision mixing/switching console during live broadcasts and recorded productions.
	Select and switch between multiple video sources, including cameras, graphics, video playback, remote feeds, and other sources.
	Execute the Producer/Director’s instructions promptly during live programmes.
	Ensure smooth and seamless transitions between shots, cameras, graphics, and other sources.
	Monitor all incoming video feeds to ensure proper picture quality, framing, colour, and signal availability.
	Work closely with the Director, Producer, Camera Operators, Sound Team, Graphics Team, and Master Control during broadcasts.
	Manage keying and layering of graphics, lower thirds, logos, captions, and other on-screen elements where required.
	Support the production of live news, breaking news, interviews, talk shows, sports, special events, and other programmes.
	Maintain concentration and respond quickly to last-minute changes and unexpected technical issues during live broadcasts.
	Perform pre-broadcast checks to ensure all required video sources are available and functioning properly. Assist with studio and outside broadcast productions, as required.
	Maintain accurate communication with the production team through intercom and other communication systems.
	Identify and report technical faults, signal issues, or equipment malfunctions promptly.
	Ensure compliance with the station's broadcast standards, technical procedures, and operational guidelines.
	Maintain proper care and safe operation of the vision mixing equipment.
	Participate in shift duties, including nights, weekends, public holidays, and other hours required for a 24-hour broadcast operation.
	Stay updated on new broadcast technologies, production workflows, and vision mixing techniques.


Person Specification


	Bachelor’s Degree / HND / OND in Mass Communication, Television/Film Production, Broadcasting, Media Technology, Electrical/  Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
	2–5 years of relevant experience as a Vision Mixer, Technical Director, or in a similar broadcast production role.
	Practical experience operating professional vision mixing/switching consoles.
	Good understanding of live television production workflows.
	Knowledge of SDI/IP video workflows, routing systems, signal flow, and broadcast equipment is an advantage.
	Strong attention to detail and excellent visual awareness.
	Good communication and teamwork skills.
	Ability to quickly interpret and execute instructions from the Director/Producer.
	Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
	Ability to work flexible shifts in a 24-hour television environment, including overnight shifts, weekends, and public holidays.
	Knowledge of broadcast software and equipment such as Ross, Grass Valley, Sony, Blackmagic Design, Vizrt, or equivalent systems is an added advantage. 


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
